subject: english
how: 根据对话情境，从选项中选择最恰当的应答，把对话补全。
knowledge_point_basis: 题型维度(E-T*) + 语言知识维度(E-G*/E-S*)，映射取自 knowledge_base.json 的 question_type_to_points
source: inbox/real_exams/*.json（只读；不从 SQLite 取题干）

rules.prefer: 有解析者优先；其次解析更长、空更多、材料更长
rules.sampling: 按 exam 轮转（每套卷先取 1 条再取第 2 条…），上限 40 条
rules.dedupe: 同题干（去空白差异）只留解析最好的一条，其余来源记在 same_stem_exams
rules.material_rule: 材料型题整组存：material 存整篇原文、material_blanks 存该组全部空（空数经断言校验）；材料型 sample 的 stem 为空串，题干在各空的 stem 里
rules.zero_rewrite: 题干/材料/答案/解析零改写；唯一渲染是把源里的 {type:'blank'} 块显式写成 {{__BLANK_<n>__}}；连词成句保留 `词组 / 词组` 斜杠格式
rules.deterministic: 不使用随机数；排序键固定为 (exam, 组内 rank)

Tom 之后提出预约下周见面，说明 Smith 现在不在公司，因此 out on business today 最合语境。

samples.explanation:
对话开头李华询问“What are you doing?”（你在做什么？），王军应回答正在进行的活动。选项G“I'm just playing an online game.”（我只是在玩网络游戏）符合语境。

王军回答“Um. I went to Liu Ming's birthday party four weeks ago.”（嗯，我四周前去了刘明的生日聚会），说明李华问的是关于上一次出门社交的时间。选项A“When was the last time you went out with friends?”（你上一次和朋友出去是什么时候？）与之衔接最自然。

空后提到“We're going for dinner. How about joining us?”（我们要去吃晚饭，一起去吗？），选项E“I'm going out with some people from our course on Saturday.”（这周六我要和课上的几个人出去）交代了活动的背景和时间，引导出后面的邀请。

李华提到“You are a good football player.”（你是个优秀的足球运动员），建议他参加不需要太多交流的活动，选项D“Why don't you join the college club?”（你为什么不加入大学俱乐部呢？）是基于足球特长的合理建议。

李华提到周日去看新电影《哪吒2》，王军紧接着说“I do need to get out more!”（我确实需要多出门走走），说明他接受了提议。选项C“I'd like to see that.”（我想看那部电影）表达了兴趣。

Li Hua: Hi, Wang Jun. What are you doing?

Wang Jun: {{__BLANK_6__}}

Li Hua: You always sit inside playing games and going online. When was the last time you had a day without going online?

Wang Jun: I don't know. Probably six months ago.

Li Hua: You should go out more. I'm meeting some friends for coffee now. Why don't you come?

Wang Jun: Thanks, but I'm fine here.

Li Hua: OK. {{__BLANK_7__}}

Wang Jun: Um. I went to Liu Ming's birthday party four weeks ago.

Li Hua: And you haven't been out since then?

Wang Jun: No. I don't really enjoy it. I get nervous.

Li Hua: {{__BLANK_8__}} We're going for dinner. How about joining us?

Wang Jun: That's my worst nightmare! I feel nervous sitting in a small group making conversations.

Li Hua: You could do something where you don't have to talk too much. You are a good football player. {{__BLANK_9__}}

Wang Jun: Actually, that sounds like a good idea.

Li Hua: OK, I'll pick up some information for you. Also, we're going to see the new movie Nezha II on Sunday.

Wang Jun: {{__BLANK_10__}} I do need to get out more! Thank you.

Li Hua: Welcome.

G. I'm just playing an online game.

samples.explanation:
前台接线后，女士紧接着提出订房需求；后文又出现 double room，可知此处应是提出预订双人房。

后一句回答每晚 130 美元，说明这里询问的是房价。

女士问“Does that include tax?”，最自然的回应是是否包含税费，A 与语境完全对应。

女士追问房费包含什么服务，后句又补充可以上网，因此这里应先说明房内配套服务。

女士询问游泳池，服务员先确认有，再说明开放时间，最后补充免费，B 最连贯。

# Ⅲ.Reading Comprehension (50 points)
Section A
Passage 1
# 【文章大意】
关于大一学生的调查告诉我们为什么大多数学生都上大学： $8 8 \%$ 想要“一个找到一份好工作的更好的机会”， $8 1 \%$ 想要变“富有和有钱”。然而，现在大多数学生不能实现这些目标。有一个仔细的研究发现，在校大学生在学习上花费的时间更少了——从 20 世纪 60年代早期的每周 25 小时变成了现在的 15 小时。
学习也能导致更好的学习成绩。获得更好的学习成绩意味着变得“有钱”的更高的机会。一份关于毕业 15 年的 20000 名校友的研究发现了下面的结果。那些班级前三名的学生比中间三名的学生挣得多得多。中间三名的学生又比倒数三名的学生挣得多。不必惊奇，那些在大学里成绩不好的人都希望他们能够在学校学习更多。
学生是应该独自学习还是和别人一起学习这个问题比较复杂。如果老师把问题留给学生解决，如果学生首先尝试自己学习，小组学习往往是有帮助的。但是仅仅和同学在一起而不单独学习似乎不利于学习。在选课方面，很多学生更喜欢作业少、评分容易的课程。
然而，选择难度更大、阅读时间更长、论文更多的课程有助于提高学习。
在大学里，仍然有大量的时间来玩。然而，研究人员再次发现，并非所有的户外活动都是有益的。一般来说，活动，如参加学生组织和与同学交谈可以更有成效。
最后，大学是一个美妙的地方，有新的兴趣，丰富你的经验，并设定你的目标。这样做的时候，你可能会重新考虑“富有和富有”是否应该是你在大学学习的主要原因。据几位调查人员称，追求金钱的人通常对他们的生活不太满意。也许他们更容易忽视更重要的事情，如家庭，朋友和工作。

Li Hua: Excuse me, sir, are you Mr. John Green from Australia?
John Green: Oh, yes, I’m John Green from Australia Trading Company Ltd.
Li Hua:{{__BLANK_6__}}I’m Li Hua, the director of Shijiazhuang Import & Export Company. And I come here specially to meet you.
John Green: How do you do, Miss Li? It’s very kind of you to come here to meet us.
Li Hua: How do you do? (They shake hands) And how many people are there in your party? Three?
John Green: Yes, three people altogether. This is Mr. Burns and this is Ms. Jones.{{__BLANK_7__}}Li Hua: Welcome to Shijiazhuang. Is this your first trip to China?
John Green: No.{{__BLANK_8__}}But this is indeed our first trip to Shijiazhuang. We take it our great honor being invited by you to visit your beautiful city.
Li Hua: Well, every city has something of its own. Shijiazhuang, the capital city of Hebei province, is one of the beautiful cities in Northern China.{{__BLANK_9__}}John Green: Thank you, Li Hua. I’m sure all of us will have a wonderful time in Shijiazhuang.
Li Hua:{{__BLANK_10__}}John Green: About a week.
Li Hua: Good. We will have enough time for our business talks. And in the interval between talks, we'll arrange a visit to the Great Wall.
John Green: Wonderful! I must say nothing would please me more. Thank you!
Li Hua: My pleasure. Let’s go to the hotel now. This way please.

B. We visit China frequently.
C. Allow me to introduce myself.
D. How long do you intend to stay?
E. Both are our delegation members.
F. When will you leave for Australia?
G. And I hope all of you will have a pleasant stay here.

学习也能导致更好的学习成绩。获得更好的学习成绩意味着变得“有钱”的更高的机会。一份关于毕业 15 年的 20000 名校友的研究发现了下面的结果。那些班级前三名的学生比中间三名的学生挣得多得多。中间三名的学生又比倒数三名的学生挣得多。不必惊奇，那些在大学里成绩不好的人都希望他们能够在学校学习更多。
学生是应该独自学习还是和别人一起学习这个问题比较复杂。如果老师把问题留给学生解决，如果学生首先尝试自己学习，小组学习往往是有帮助的。但是仅仅和同学在一起而不单独学习似乎不利于学习。在选课方面，很多学生更喜欢作业少、评分容易的课程。
然而，选择难度更大、阅读时间更长、论文更多的课程有助于提高学习。
在大学里，仍然有大量的时间来玩。然而，研究人员再次发现，并非所有的户外活动都是有益的。一般来说，活动，如参加学生组织和与同学交谈可以更有成效。
最后，大学是一个美妙的地方，有新的兴趣，丰富你的经验，并设定你的目标。这样做的时候，你可能会重新考虑“富有和富有”是否应该是你在大学学习的主要原因。据几位调查人员称，追求金钱的人通常对他们的生活不太满意。也许他们更容易忽视更重要的事情，如家庭，朋友和工作。

Dan: Hi, Jean. How's it going?
Jean: Oh, hello Dan. Pretty well, thanks. {{__BLANK_6__}}
Dan: Not yet. Would you like to give me some advice?
Jean: Well, the first thing is to find out exactly what's required in the exams.
Dan: Right, I'll do that. Then what?
Jean: Then you can organize your learning, based on what's probably coming up.
Dan: Uhuh.
Jean: But that isn't enough in itself. You also need a timetable, to see how you can fit everything in the time available. Then keep it in front of you while you're studying.
Dan: {{__BLANK_7__}} However, it wasn't enough!
Jean: Maybe you need to do something different every day. {{__BLANK_8__}} With big topics, it might be possible for you to put off starting.
Dan: Good idea.
Jean: And after I review each topic, I read it quickly, and it helps fix things in my mind.
Dan: That's helpful.
Jean: {{__BLANK_9__}} It's hard to make myself do it, though.
Dan: Well, I'll try to do more exercises. Thanks a lot, Jean. That's a great help.
Jean: No problem.
Dan: {{__BLANK_10__}}
Jean: Bye.

B. Are you doing anything else?
C. See you soon.
D. Have you managed to prepare your exams?
E. I still practice a lot for the exams.

G. I also do some sports.

Li Hua: Hi, Wang Jun. What are you doing?{{__BLANK_6__}}Li Hua: You always sit inside playing games and going online. When was the last time you had a day without going online?

Wang Jun: I don't know. Probably six months ago.

Li Hua: You should go out more. I'm meeting some friends for coffee now. Why don't you come?

Wang Jun: Thanks, but I'm fine here.

Li Hua:{{__BLANK_7__}}Wang Jun: Um. I went to Liu Ming's birthday party four weeks ago.

Li Hua: And you haven't been out since then?

Wang Jun: No. I don't really enjoy it. I get nervous.

Li Hua:{{__BLANK_8__}}We're going for dinner. How about joining us?

Wang Jun: That's my worst nightmare! I feel nervous sitting in a small group making conversations.

Li Hua: You could do something where you don't have to talk too much. You are a good football player.{{__BLANK_9__}}Wang Jun: Actually, that sounds like a good idea.

Li Hua: OK, I'll pick up some information for you. Also, we're going to see the new movie Nezha II on Sunday.

Wang Jun:{{__BLANK_10__}}I do need to get out more! Thank you.

Li Hua: Welcome.

B. That's why I do it online.
C. I'd like to see that.
D. Why don't you join the college club?
E. I'm going out with some people from our course on Saturday.
F. Which one do you like better?
G. I'm just playing an online game.
